rules: All 3D GLB files, regardless of subject, must live directly in assets/models/.
Do not rename a referenced file without updating data/sites.json, js/sites.js and/or js/board.js.
Required runtime assets must exist; planned and optional paths are allowed to be missing and must be reported.
Any GLB added to assets/models/ but absent from this manifest is reported as a new/unregistered asset.
The audit script checks file presence, GLB container structure, filename, references, size and SHA-256 inventory; it does not validate model geometry quality or licence rights.
A model with previewUrl can be displayed from its external GLB while a local self-hosted copy is missing. The audit still reports the local copy as missing if its manifest path does not exist.
